name: Woodman Van Nuys
demographics: Woodman Van Nuys serves a diverse, predominantly Hispanic community with a population of 284,567 within three miles. The trade area features middle to upper-middle income households averaging $104,521 annually, with average home values of $749,841, indicating a stable residential market. The center attracts families and working professionals from the surrounding Van Nuys and Arleta neighborhoods, with strong daytime traffic of 229,952 people supporting consistent weekday shopping patterns. The anchor tenant EL SUPER caters specifically to Hispanic shoppers seeking authentic groceries and cultural products, while the center's location next to a high school drives additional youth and family traffic throughout the week.
description: Woodman Van Nuys is a thriving 107,613 square foot community shopping center strategically located at 9700-9710 Woodman Avenue in the heart of Arleta, California. Anchored by EL SUPER, a high-volume Hispanic grocer that serves as the cornerstone tenant, this center has established itself as an essential neighborhood destination in one of Los Angeles' most densely populated markets. The property benefits from exceptional visibility and accessibility, positioned adjacent to a local high school which generates consistent foot traffic and creates a natural gathering place for the community. With over 1.5 million annual visits, Woodman Van Nuys has proven its appeal to the surrounding population of nearly 285,000 residents within a three-mile radius. The center operates daily from 6:00 AM to 11:00 PM, providing extended hours that accommodate the busy schedules of working families and students alike. Managed by Regency Centers, a nationally recognized shopping center developer and operator, the property maintains high standards of maintenance and tenant mix curation. The center's strong 4.3-star rating from nearly 2,000 Google reviews reflects its reputation as a reliable, well-maintained shopping destination that successfully serves the diverse needs of the Van Nuys community.
summary: Woodman Van Nuys is a 107,613 square foot community shopping center anchored by EL SUPER, a high-volume Hispanic grocer serving the dense Arleta neighborhood. Located next to a local high school, the center attracts over 1.5 million annual visits from a diverse community of nearly 285,000 residents within three miles.
